title: I tested supercooled water…and it worked! To make supercooled water a...
description: I tested supercooled water…and it worked! To make supercooled water at home: 1. Grab an unopened Fiji water bottle (but you can use any water - freezing temps and times may vary). 2. Place unopened bottle in the freezer for 2 hours. 3. Gently remove from freezer.  4. Tap or smack your bottle against a counter. If it’s supercooled, it will instantly freeze. Our next hurdle to jump over is: 1. Make an instant ice tower with supercooled water. 2. Make a supercooled fruit by submerging it in supercooled water.  3. Make supercooled water with spring water bottle (and not just a Fiji water bottle). Y’all know I am determined to make them work!
